semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company focuses on wastewater treatment and resource recovery, which are not core semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Enviro-Innovate Tech specializes in the research and development of technologies for recovering ammonia from wastewater and converting industrial waste into fuel gas. Their solutions aim to enhance resource recovery and promote environmental sustainability, but they do not directly supply semiconductor manufacturing equipment or materials.
capabilities: Conversion of organic waste solvents into fuel gas

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has developed high-purity electronic grade liquid ammonia recovery technology specifically in Taiwan.
